title: Comparative analysis of waterlogging and drought stress regulatory networks in barley (Hordeum vulgare).
one_liner_zh: 该文用系统生物学和机器学习构建大麦胁迫下的基因调控网络，涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We applied a systems biology approach to gain a deep insight into the regulatory mechanisms of barley (Hordeum vulgare ) under drought and waterlogging stress conditions. To identify informative models related to stress conditions, we constructed meta-analysis and two distinct weighted gene co-expression networks. We then performed module trait association analyses. Additionally, we conducted functional enrichment analysis of significant modules to shed light on the biological performance of underlying genes in the two contrasting stresses. In the next step, we inferred the gene regulatory networks between top hub genes of significant modules, kinases, and transcription factors (TFs) using a machine learning algorithm. Our results showed that at power=10, the scale-free topology fitting index (R2) was higher than 0.8 and the connectivity mean became stable. We identified 31 co-expressed gene modules in barley, with 13 and 14 modules demonstrating significant associations with drought and waterlogging stress, respectively. Functional enrichment analysis indicated that these stress-responsive modules are involved in critical processes, including ADP-rybosylation factors (ARF) protein signal transduction, ethylene-induced autophagy, and phosphoric ester hydrolase activity. Specific TFs and kinases, such as C2C2-GATA, HB-BELL, and MADS-MIKC, were identified as key regulators under these stress conditions. Furthermore, certain TFs and kinases established unique connections with hub genes in response to waterlogging and drought conditions. These findings enhance our understanding of the molecular networks that modulate barley's response to drought and waterlogging stresses, offering insights into the regulatory mechanisms essential for stress adaptation.
abstract_zh: 我们采用系统生物学方法，深入探究大麦（Hordeum vulgare）在干旱和水涝胁迫条件下的调控机制。为识别与胁迫条件相关的信息模型，我们构建了荟萃分析（meta-analysis）和两个不同的加权基因共表达网络。随后，我们进行了模块-性状关联分析。此外，我们对显著模块进行了功能富集分析，以阐明这两种对比胁迫下相关基因的生物学功能。下一步，我们利用机器学习算法推断显著模块中核心枢纽基因、激酶和转录因子（TFs）之间的基因调控网络。结果表明，在power=10时，无标度拓扑拟合指数（R2）高于0.8，且连接度均值趋于稳定。我们在大麦中鉴定出31个共表达基因模块，其中13个和14个模块分别与干旱和水涝胁迫显著相关。功能富集分析表明，这些胁迫响应模块涉及关键过程，包括ADP-核糖基化因子（ARF）蛋白信号转导、乙烯诱导的自噬以及磷酸酯水解酶活性。特定转录因子和激酶，如C2C2-GATA、HB-BELL和MADS-MIKC，被鉴定为这些胁迫条件下的关键调控因子。此外，某些转录因子和激酶在水涝和干旱响应中与枢纽基因建立了独特连接。这些发现增进了我们对调控大麦响应干旱和水涝胁迫的分子网络的理解，为胁迫适应所必需的调控机制提供了见解。
